extensionAttribute.description: Returns the FlexNet Fulfillment ID for installed Tableau Desktop, or "Not_Installed". Tableau still bundles the FlexNet custactutil helper on macOS.
extensionAttribute.scriptContentsMac:
#!/bin/zsh
# Updated by SecurityShrimp 2026 # Tableau Fulfillment ID Extension Attribute # Targets macOS 12 through 26 (Tahoe), Intel and Apple Silicon # Tableau versions the bundle directory (Tableau.app or Tableau Desktop.app); # we glob both.
custactutil="" for app in "/Applications/Tableau.app" "/Applications/Tableau Desktop.app"; do [[ -x "$app/Contents/Frameworks/FlexNet/custactutil" ]] && custactutil="$app/Contents/Frameworks/FlexNet/custactutil" && break done
if [[ -z "$custactutil" ]]; then echo "<result>Not_Installed</result>" exit 0 fi
fid=$("$custactutil" -view 2>/dev/null | /usr/bin/awk -F': ' '/Fulfillment ID:/ { print $2 }' | /usr/bin/tail -n1)
echo "<result>${fid:-Unknown}</result>"
